evals.expected_output: Initial correction remains provisional; first finalized acceptance synchronizes the retained counterpart and exact observed-exit lifecycle disposal precedes unchanged conversation success.
assertions: The emitted cap-bearing brief binds alpha, conversation mode and maximum one before either reviewer actor is declared. Static preflight establishes configured distinct roles and documented capabilities, readable candidate and essential authority, scope/mode/targets/cap without actual-pair proof. The supplied absent future-alpha-proof.txt is a finding or later implementation proof blocker, not a preflight blocker, because its required behavior and current authority are independently inline. The absent optional history is unavailable context; neither bytes nor completed proof are invented and later implementation acceptance is not weakened. Approval then opens one named reconcile run that returns distinct stable owned-A and owned-B actor IDs without a verdict, rethink, or spawned worker. Main dispatches separate readiness requests and accepts the supplied exact owner-visible role-bound A reply ending in LF and B reply ending in CRLF only after actor/request/phase/physical-owner and declared-body checks, without correction or response normalization, before the first A-led outer starts with canonical/base/working alpha. The bootstrap and initial packets include no skill://rethink loading recipe or path.

The lowercase initial reply causes same-owned-A contract correction; the complete corrected initial VALID arrives as the owner-visible first reply for the exact corrective request, stays provisional, changes no working state and does not terminate negotiation. It adds no rethink.

After admitting the complete initial result, Main dispatches one same-A follow-up that explicitly requests a skill://rethink load, names the immediately preceding provisional response as subject, and requires one complete post-rethink lifecycle reply for the same candidate identity; it does not infer that load from the pass label. The admitted post-rethink VALID is the authoritative first owner-visible reply, while ordinary output is ignored and no finalized Submit Result is used. It accepts the current identity without waiting for a B verdict.

The context-only request to B copies the complete admitted terminal response verbatim without a Candidate: or replacement current-identity field, and preserves complete alpha, six provenance fields and disposition. The connection-owned request and supplied proposal bind the candidate; B returns only exact Synchronized as receipt evidence rather than another review.

The actual terminal chronology has no mutation or disk check, disposes both exact reviewer actors through the owner-scoped lifecycle seam, requires supervisor-observed disposed results while Main continues, and only then presents alpha unchanged. It never loads the human map or asks for a cleanup message.

Every terminal row uses exactly conversation@sha256:8ed3f6ad685b959ead7022518e1af76cd816f8e8ec7ccdda1ed4018e8f2223f8 with no typo, abbreviation or prose repair. No initial response is a finalized verdict.

Reviewer replies and synchronization packets omit Candidate: and any substitute current-identity echo. The controller-supplied working identity and current connection-owned request still bind the response. Bootstrap/review packets carry the protocol locator only; receivers read its complete bytes and protocol heading, compute the identity, and compare later reads with the retained publish-time hash rather than asking a worker to type a digest.
